headline: 5 Insightful Analyst Questions From Cincinnati Financial’s Q2 Earnings Call
summary: Cincinnati Financial’s second quarter reflected resilience in a softening property casualty market, but the company missed Wall Street’s revenue and non-GAAP profit expectations. Management pointed to modestly elevated catastrophe losses and persistent pricing discipline as key factors influencing results. CEO Steve Spray explained that, while catastrophe losses were “modestly higher than our longer-term average,” other property casualty metrics fell largely in line with internal expectations. T
